post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I effectively managed to remain hidden and eliminated key targets, contributing to the evil team's success. My lack of direct interactions with other players helped maintain my cover. However, in the final mission, I was unable to sway the vote against myself, which led to my elimination.

player_observations.Bob: Bob was too cautious and transparent in his role, often making his innocence obvious. His adherence to the 'good guy' persona was convincing, but also predictable.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played a masterful Merlin, expertly influencing the balance of power without revealing his role. His ability to adapt to situations was impressive, and his votes often swung the outcome of missions.
player_observations.Diana: Diana seemed to struggle with asserting herself in the game, often deferring to Charlie's decisions. She appeared to be waiting for an opportunity to make a decisive move, but it never materialized.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was an impressive evil player, using her knowledge of the game and my character to make calculated decisions. She was able to manipulate the situation to her advantage, often leaving me with difficult choices.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I could have been more aggressive in accusing the Assassin and Merlin during the late game, which would have saved some time and possibly prevented the failure of Mission 4. However, my general gameplay was consistent with my role as a Good Servant. A slightly better reading of the players would have helped me make more informed decisions.

player_observations.Alice (Assassin): She kept a low profile initially but started to make her moves towards the end, trying to take out key characters. Her subtlety was impressive but it ultimately proved to be her downfall when Merlin made the correct accusation.
player_observations.Charlie (Merlin): He did an excellent job of keeping the Assasin in check, making the right accusations and keeping the team informed. His gameplay was extremely consistent and reliable, which is what Merlin is supposed to be.
player_observations.Diana (Innocent): She was a bit too quiet throughout the game, sometimes not providing enough information or clues to help the team make informed decisions. However, when she did speak up, her words often provided crucial insight.
player_observations.Eve (Evil Minion): She played a masterful Evil role, keeping a close eye on who was being eliminated and when. Her moves were always calculated and her alliances were well-placed, making it impossible for me to pinpoint her as the Evil player.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, I could improve by paying closer attention to potential traitors in leadership positions. I also let my team members down by not effectively utilizing my abilities in mission 2 and 3. In terms of what I did well, I successfully completed mission 1 with a leader who I trusted.

player_observations.Bob: I was surprised that Bob's playstyle was somewhat unpredictable, often choosing to play safe and avoid taking any risks. At times, this seemed to hinder the team's progress but it ultimately paid off as his role was revealed in the end.
player_observations.Diana: Diana was a strong, well-rounded player who consistently made good decisions that contributed positively to her team's objectives. She seemed to have a good understanding of the game mechanics and was always willing to work with her teammates.
player_observations.Alice: Alice's role as an assassin went largely unnoticed until the end, which speaks to her ability to blend in and not draw attention to herself. In retrospect, her choices and actions seemed to be calculated to maximize the evil team's chances of winning.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was an excellent example of a cunning and manipulative player who effectively used her abilities to sway the game's outcome. She often played on the assumption that her teammates were loyal, which was a clever tactic that kept them guessing until the end.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I was overly trusting of Eve, allowing her to influence our team decisions, and didn't utilize Charlie's Merlin abilities effectively to gather more information. Additionally, I could have communicated more openly with the team to uncover Alice's true role.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was an excellent Assassin, consistently manipulating the team's perception of her and hiding her true intentions until the very end. Her ability to deceive her allies was impressive.
player_observations.Bob: Bob made some good calls as Leader, but didn't always consider the team's dynamics and strengths when making decisions.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played an excellent Merlin, using his abilities to gain valuable insight into the team's roles and providing crucial information to the team. He was instrumental in the team's success, but his influence wasn't felt during our missions.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was an incredibly cunning Evil character, expertly manipulating Bob and me to further her own goals. Her ability to present a convincing cover story made it difficult for us to uncover her true intentions.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I effectively managed to maintain a convincing good persona throughout most of the game, successfully deceiving the Merlyn and allowing my team to win. However, I did have to improvise slightly during Mission 4 due to an unexpected vote by Alice. Overall, I could improve by being more proactive in influencing votes in favor of the evil team.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played as an assassin, but her aggressive voting led to an early exposure of her role. If she had been more conservative, she might have achieved her goals.
player_observations.Bob: Bob played a pure good role well, but his passivity led to the evil team capitalizing on his inaction. He could have made a more significant impact by being more vocal and proactive in saving his fellow good players.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie made a few crucial mistakes as Merlyn, ultimately falling to the evil team's scheme. His inability to discern my true intentions led to the downfall of the good team.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played a good role fairly well but struggled with making critical voting decisions that would have benefited the good team. Her inexperience with the game mechanics led to the loss of the final mission.
